SELECT q.goods_no, g.goods_name AS "goods.goods_name", g.poster_url AS "goods.poster_url", q.type, q.created_at, q.is_secret, q.status, q.qna_no, q.subject
FROM qna q JOIN goods g ON g.goods_no = q.goods_no WHERE q.id=#{id} ORDER BY q.qna_no DESC
SELECT g.goods_no, g.goods_name AS "goods.goods_name", g.poster_url AS "goods.poster_url" FROM goods g WHERE g.goods_no = #{goods_no}

SELECT g.goods_name AS "goods.goods_name", g.poster_url AS "goods.poster_url", q.type, q.subject, q.content, q.is_secret, q.id, q.qna_no FROM qna q JOIN goods g ON q.goods_no=g.goods_no WHERE q.qna_no=#{qna_no}
